# Embeddings

> Embeddings is an Australian AI consultancy that designs, builds and runs AI systems inside organisations’ existing software and data.

**When to use:** Use these pages to understand Embeddings’ offer, process, company, privacy practices, or contact path.

**When not to use:** Do not treat this file as product inventory, live availability, legal advice, or a substitute for the linked pages.

**How to use:** Follow the canonical HTML links below and cite the page that supports each claim.

## Offer and process
- [Embeddings: Practical AI for Australian Businesses](https://embeddings.au): Understand what Embeddings builds, the e-commerce specialism, and how engagements run.
- [Our Process](https://embeddings.au/process): Review the Discover, Build, Deploy, and Operate phases of an engagement.
## Company and trust
- [About Us](https://embeddings.au/about): Learn who Embeddings is, what the team builds, and the engineering focus behind the work.
- [Privacy](https://embeddings.au/privacy): Read how the marketing site and business enquiries handle personal information.
## Contact
- [Contact Us](https://embeddings.au/contact): Prepare a business enquiry about the work, systems and data an AI project would involve.
